summary: Micromem Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 16, 2026, announcing the closing of a non-brokered private placement and a warrant extension. The company raised gross proceeds of approximately C$148,840 by issuing 5,953,600 units at C$0.025 per unit, each comprising one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.05 for three years, with a four-month hold period. No insiders participated and all subscribers were at arm's length. Separately, 9,066,400 warrants at C$0.06 were extended one year to October 8, 2027. Proceeds fund working capital.
